value.rationale: The result targets the source’s central multistability and offset-boosting phenomena: all bounded branches must share the exact forcing-selected long-time \(x\)-RMS \(\sqrt b\), so the law is a natural model diagnostic rather than an arbitrary slice. It also gives a sharp no-bounded-solution barrier for \(b<0\) and a positive activity defect \(\int y^2-b=a^{-2}\int\dot x^2\) for compact recurrent statistics. At the published \(b=25\), the exact RMS \(5\) applies simultaneously to all three displayed coexisting branches and every bounded offset-boosted branch.
